rows.Common Mistakes: Feature dumping before belief shift; sending cold hooks to product-aware PDP only.
rows.Channel Role: Scale fast, validate hooks and angles, feed winners into CRO and CRM.
rows.Pacing: Hook in first 1.5 seconds, proof by second 5.
rows.CTA Style: Shop now, take the quiz, learn what your scale misses.
rows.Proof Style: Product demo, app screenshots, customer language, simple mechanism.
rows.Landing-Page Recommendation: Match TOF hooks to listicle or problem-aware LP.

rows.Common Mistakes: Assuming YouTube viewers know the product category.
rows.Channel Role: Longer explanation for mechanism, comparison and decision confidence.
rows.Ideal Length: 30-90s for shorts/demand gen; 2-4 min for long-form explainers.
rows.Pacing: Open with problem, build mechanism, show demo, close with proof.
rows.CTA Style: Learn more; see how Hume measures progress.
rows.Landing-Page Recommendation: Send to educational/product landing pages with deeper proof.

rows.Channel Role: Reinforce education, objection handling, post-purchase success and cross-sell.
rows.Ideal Length: Short emails/SMS with one belief shift each.
rows.Pacing: One insight, one proof, one action.
rows.CTA Style: Open the app, complete setup, shop compatible product.
rows.Proof Style: Usage tips, trend interpretation, safe customer language.
rows.Landing-Page Recommendation: Send to product education, onboarding or offer-specific pages.

rows.Common Mistakes: Overproduced performance-ad feel or medical-sounding claims.
rows.Channel Role: Creator-led discovery, raw product demo and relatable confession hooks.
rows.Pacing: Native, quick cuts, high first-frame curiosity.
rows.CTA Style: See your own body composition; check the link.
rows.Proof Style: Creator use case and visible app reveal.
rows.Landing-Page Recommendation: Use quiz/listicle or UGC-congruent bridge pages.

rows.Common Mistakes: Ad says plateau, page says generic smart scale.
rows.Channel Role: Convert ad promise into a page promise without breaking belief congruence.
rows.Ideal Length: As long as needed to resolve the awareness stage.
rows.Best Hook Types: Headline must mirror ad hook or new belief.
rows.Pacing: Above-the-fold: persona, problem, promise, proof, CTA.
rows.CTA Style: Product-aware CTA for PDP; educational CTA for cold traffic.
rows.Proof Style: Approved claims, app visuals, comparison tables, review language.

rows.Common Mistakes: Trying to test too many claims in one spot.
rows.Channel Role: Broad awareness and belief shift, especially category education.
rows.Pacing: Clear single idea, no dense UI copy.
rows.CTA Style: Search Hume Health or visit HumeHealth.com <http://HumeHealth.com>.
rows.Proof Style: Human story plus simple product reveal.
rows.Landing-Page Recommendation: Use memorable hero promise and consistent post-view retargeting page.
